Form Controls

Inputs, checkboxes, radios, and fieldsets share the visual family of .btn: same border, same focus ring, same disabled treatment. Inputs read as an inset well (you type into them) while checkboxes and radios re-use the raised .btn shape and fill with --color-primary when checked. Fieldsets are flat frames — no drop shadow — that group related fields under a small-caps legend.

Text Inputs

Apply .input to any single-line form control. Layout (width, stretch) is owned by the surrounding container — the component sets only the chrome.

Input Types

.input works on every native text-like control — email, number, search, date, file, plus <textarea> and <select>. The chevron on a styled <select> is rendered via background-image so it's consistent across browsers.

Prefix & Suffix Affixes

Wrap an .input in .input-group to render non-interactive labels — currency, units, a per-period suffix — inside the field's border. The wrapper carries the chrome (border, focus swap, disabled / read-only / invalid surfaces); the inner input drops its own border so the affix and the editable value read as a single field. Same pattern as the .timepicker__field hosting its inline timezone picker. Use a <span> for inert labels and a <button> if the affix should be interactive (e.g., a unit toggle).

Field States

Six canonical states every text-like field supports — empty disabled, empty read-only, both filled equivalents, an invalid field showing the error helper, and a labelled field inside a form. Disabled paints the muted-surface shell and freezes interaction; read-only flips to the secondary surface but stays focusable; invalid is opted into via aria-invalid="true" (the same hook native form validation toggles on submit) and pairs with a .field-error helper underneath.

Textarea & Select States

textarea.input and select.input pick up the same six-state vocabulary. Disabled freezes both; read-only flips a textarea to the muted surface while a select doesn't accept readonly natively, so consumers either lock the value with disabled or render the chosen option as non-editable text.

Checkboxes

Native <input type="checkbox"> with the UA chrome stripped and re-rendered as a small .btn-shaped square. Sized in em so the box tracks its label's font-size automatically.

Checkboxes also scale with surrounding text:

Radio Buttons

Same shape as .checkbox but circular and with a dot instead of a tick. Group radios with a shared name in the usual native way.

Fieldset

.fieldset is a flat frame for grouping related fields. Pair it with native <legend> for an accessible group label that browsers expose to assistive tech.

Notification preferences

Composed Form

Inputs, checkboxes, radios, fieldsets, and buttons composed together — everything shares the same border, focus ring, and disabled treatment.
